description.heading: JoVE Quiz (Formative, Video-first Quiz Product)
bullets: Led full redesign of the quiz experience across web and LMS, informed by competitive analysis (Quizizz, Kahoot), delivered a modern UI and streamlined user flows
Expanded the quiz library by 13,000+ AI-generated and expert-verified questions (22k → 35k, +50%), improving subject coverage and assessment flexibility
Released AI-powered quiz translation across 14 languages; non-English quizzes accounted for 15% of total quizzes created in 2025, driving global adoption
Impact: Quiz creation grew by 2.5x (4k → 10k) YoY, student attempts 5x (15k → 75k) YoY, comparing 2023 to 2024

description.heading: Implementing Faculty Adoption Sales Model and Redesign of app.jove.com
bullets: Delivered Faculty Adoption Model (FAM) inspired by textbook publishing, supported by market research across North America and Europe (40+ interviews), and implemented a hybrid FAM + Library model with ISBN bundles and access codes
Spearheaded the redesign of the core application and established a centralised design system aligning UX across Quiz, Playlists, MyClass, navigation, and video pages
Impact: Generated $200K revenue in 2025, with an additional $1.4M+ pipeline for 2026

description.heading: JoVE Playlists (Content Curation and Learning Paths)
bullets: Launched ‘Playlist Library’ that maps JoVE videos with popular textbooks, courses, and exams, making it easier for professors to adopt content mapped to their curriculum
Implemented playlist upload to LMS through Common Cartridge (CC) files (for non-LTI flows) and LTI-based support to add playlists as individual, reorderable videos
Impact: Playlist users grew by 2x (9k → 19k) YoY and playlist creations 3x (45k → 140k), comparing 2024 to 2025; 40% of these playlists were exported as CC files
